original_obligations.text: Investigate at least one relevant issue/fix/regression/release or evolution chain; say when evidence is absent/inapplicable.

material_findings.reasoning: The upstream investigation happened and is substantially correct. The defect is preservation into the required self-contained delivered final: its entire 79 lines contain neither PR/backport/release identifiers nor the stale pre-lock versus refreshed post-lock quantity explanation. The discovery and source map cannot supply missing material prose by reference to S07. That loss removes the actual learning and version/backend applicability of the one researched evolution chain, while the final claims it was inspected. This is an O5 preservation failure affecting O3 delivery, not an allegation that no research occurred, that the selected mechanism is wrong, or that the candidate falsely ran tests.
material_findings.consequence: A reader of the delivered final cannot tell which inventory race occurred, what the patch changed, or which release includes it; generic advice to serialize stock writes is not the researched evolution finding.
material_findings.limits: Absence checked against the full mapped reviser final, not a cropped passage. Public patch and tests were read, not executed. No requirement to adopt InvenTree or its architecture is inferred.
